displayName: Compliance Audit and Due-Diligence Review (Data Stays Home, Logic Stays Yours)
description: For investment due diligence, supplier audits, internal-control and data-compliance checks — the reviewer seals its checking logic into a package for the auditee, who runs it against its local database and returns only a summary. Data never leaves the auditee; the logic is never readable

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
